system.notes:
Champion | Leader

Ancient, dreadful and beautiful. All shall love her and despair!
Motives & Tactics: Command, cultivate, drive out, preserve

Difficulty: 19 | Thresholds: 14/27 | HP: 8 | Stress: 5

ATK: +4 | Shortbow: Far | 2d10+1 physical

Experience: The Occult & Obscure +4, Forest Knowledge +4

Features

Sidhe Labyrinth - Action: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Create a area that covers an area within Close of that point. All targets within that area take 2d6+2 physical damage when they act. A target must succeed on a Finesse Roll or deal more than 20 damage to the Queen with an attack to leave the area.

We Are All One - Reaction: When an ally dies within Close range, you can spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress as the fallen ally’s life force is returned to Bryn Bresail.
